sections.title: Preservation form: protect one ally
paragraphs: This entry covers the four-star Ice Preservation version of March 7th. Her main purpose is to shield a chosen ally and react when a shielded ally is attacked. GameBreak practice suggestion: inspect the next enemy action before selecting the recipient. A shield placed on the wrong teammate will not protect everyone from a team-wide attack.

sections.title: Shield, counter and Freeze
paragraphs: The Skill creates a shield based on March’s DEF and can raise the protected ally’s chance of being targeted under its stated HP condition. Her Talent supplies limited counterattacks, while the Ultimate attacks all enemies and can Freeze them. Read unlocked Traces and Eidolons separately: a later upgrade must not be assumed in a fresh account’s starting kit.

sections.title: Early-story access, separate forms
paragraphs: The Preservation form is obtained during the early Trailblaze story. This does not make every version of March the same unit: the Hunt form has a different combat role and kit. When following a guide, match both the character name and the Path. The site’s entry identifier keeps this Ice version distinct from the Imaginary Hunt record.

sections.title: A camera and a missing past
paragraphs: The official character description presents March as an enthusiastic photographer awakened from drifting ice without her former memories. She takes the date of that awakening as her name and travels aboard the Astral Express. Her official trailer focuses on that energetic, photo-loving personality. Later revelations are intentionally omitted here so the starting profile remains useful without major story spoilers.

sections.title: Do not confuse a chance with a guarantee
paragraphs: Practical checklist: check shield duration, remaining shield strength and the enemy’s next attack pattern. Freeze may fail against resistant targets, and higher target likelihood is not a guaranteed taunt. Use a basic attack when protection is still sufficient and the team needs Skill Points. Test the actual encounter; neither this profile nor an old video proves solo-sustain performance in every mode.

history.label: Original playable form
history.detail: The community record lists Ice Preservation March as a Version 1.0 character. Her April 2022 official trailer predates the 26 April 2023 launch and is historical promotional footage.

sections.title: Wind Hunt: focus the priority target
paragraphs: This is the original four-star Wind Hunt Dan Heng, a single-target attacker. GameBreak practice suggestion: select the enemy that most urgently needs to be defeated, then check its Wind weakness and Slow state before committing the Ultimate. A lower-health add and a dangerous boss are different tactical choices; do not choose only by the largest visible damage number.

sections.title: Slow and ally-targeted support
paragraphs: His Skill can apply Slow after a critical hit, and his Ultimate gains an additional benefit against a slowed target. When an ally’s ability targets him, his Talent can improve the Wind resistance penetration of his next attack, subject to its cooldown. These conditions make action order important: check which attack will consume the prepared benefit before pressing an ability.

sections.title: Use the matching character record
paragraphs: The Wind Hunt form joins during the early Trailblaze story. Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae and Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae are separate playable records with different Paths, elements and skill systems. A guide for either later version should not be used as the build instructions for this entry. Match the portrait, Path and element before spending development materials.

sections.title: Guard of the Astral Express
paragraphs: The official archive describes a reserved traveler carrying the spear Cloud-Piercer and guarding the Astral Express. His reluctance to discuss the past is part of his initial characterization, not a missing stat field. This overview leaves later identity revelations to the story. The media gallery contains material from multiple eras, so read each caption before treating an image as this combat form.

sections.title: A repeatable comparison
paragraphs: Practical checklist: keep the same enemy and build, record whether Slow landed, and note the supporting ability used before the attack. Compare the prepared Ultimate with an unprepared one rather than mixing the results. Remember that a single-target attacker may spend extra turns clearing groups. These are suggested checks, not a current endgame ranking or a promise of a particular damage total.

history.label: Original form and later identities
history.detail: The original record is Wind and The Hunt. Later character names refer to distinct playable forms; this dossier deliberately keeps their mechanics separate rather than merging every Dan Heng ability into one kit.

skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Explicit Subsidy
skills.description: Summons Numby to tag along in a map. Numby will automatically search for Basic Treasures and Trotters nearby. Using Technique will regenerate Energy for Topaz after Numby's first attack in the next battle.

levels.description:
Summons Numby when Topaz enters the overworld. Numby will automatically search for Basic Treasures and Trotters within a set radius.
Using her Technique will regenerate 60 Energy for Topaz after Numby's first attack in the next battle.
If Topaz is still in the team after using her Technique and defeating overworld enemies, a small bonus amount of credits will be added to the earned credits. A maximum of 10,000 bonus credits can be received per calendar day.
After using her Technique and defeating enemies in Simulated Universe or Divergent Universe, additionally receive a small amount of Cosmic Fragments with a small chance to obtain 1 random Curio.

ranks.description:
When enemies afflicted with "Proof of Debt" receive Follow-Up ATKs, they will enter the "Debtor" state. This can take effect only once within a single attack.
The "Debtor" state increases the CRIT DMG of Follow-Up ATKs inflicted on the enemy target by 25%, stacking up to 2 time(s). When "Proof of Debt" is removed, the "Debtor" state is also removed.

skills.name: Crescent Transmigration
skills.description: When possessing 2 stack(s) of "Syzygy," Jingliu enters the "Spectral Transmigration" state with her action advanced by 100%, her CRIT Rate increased, and her Skill enhanced. Using an attack in the "Spectral Transmigration" state consumes HP from her teammates. And when ally targets receive DMG or consume HP, Jingliu's CRIT DMG increases. When "Syzygy" stacks become 0, exits the "Spectral Transmigration" state.

levels.description: When Jingliu has 2 stacks of "Syzygy," she enters the "Spectral Transmigration" state with 1 extra stack of "Syzygy" gained, her action advanced by 100%, and her CRIT Rate increased by 40%. Then, Jingliu's Skill "Transcendent Flash" is enhanced to "Moon On Glacial River," and only this enhanced Skill is available for use in battle. When Jingliu uses an attack in the Spectral Transmigration state, she consumes HP from her teammates equal to 5% of their respective Max HP (this cannot reduce teammates' HP to lower than 1). During the "Spectral Transmigration" state, when ally targets receive DMG or consume HP, Jingliu gains 1 stack of "Moonlight." Each "Moonlight" stack increases Jingliu's CRIT DMG by 22%, stacking up to 5 time(s). Jingliu cannot enter the "Spectral Transmigration" state again until the current "Spectral Transmigration" state ends. "Syzygy" can stack up to 4 times. When "Syzygy" stacks become 0, Jingliu will exit the "Spectral Transmigration" state and remove all "Moonlight." After ally targets receive DMG or consume HP for a total of 20 times, Jingliu gains 1 stack of "Syzygy." Each attack received by each target is only counted once.

skills.description:

Makes this unit enter the "Torrid Scorch" state, enhancing Basic ATK. When ally units with "Foxian Prayer" attack, Fugue has a high chance to reduce the enemy target's DEF.

levels.description:
Grants one designated ally "Foxian Prayer". Enters the "Torrid Scorch" state, lasting for 3 turn(s). The duration decreases by 1 at the start of Fugue's every turn. "Foxian Prayer" only takes effect on the most recent target of Fugue's Skill.
The ally target with "Foxian Prayer" increases their Break Effect by 15% and can also reduce Toughness even when attacking enemies that don't have the corresponding Weakness Type, with the effect equivalent to 50% of the original Toughness Reduction value. This cannot stack with other Toughness Reduction effects that also ignore Weakness Type.

Every time an enemy target receives DoT at the start of each turn, there is a 50% base chance for it to be inflicted with 1 stack of Arcana.
While afflicted with Arcana, enemy targets receive Wind DoT equal to 96% of Black Swan's ATK at the start of each turn. Each stack of Arcana increases this DMG multiplier by 4.8%. Then Arcana resets to 1 stack. Arcana can stack up to 50 times.

skills.description:
When Slashed Dream reaches its upper limit, the Ultimate can be activated. During the Ultimate, reduces enemies' Toughness regardless of Weakness Types and reduces all enemies' All-Type RES.
When any unit inflicts debuffs on an enemy target while using their ability, Acheron gains Slashed Dream and inflicts Crimson Knot on an enemy target.

skills.name: The Hospitable Dolosian
skills.description:
Cipher causes one enemy target to enter the "Patron" state. After the target in this state gets attacked by teammates, Cipher launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Quantum DMG to the target. This can trigger 1 time(s) per turn.
Cipher will keep a tally of the DMG dealt by allies to the target in the "Patron" state. After using Ultimate, clears this tally.

Khaslana's Talent. Upon transformation, gains 4 point(s) of "Scourge". If this happens during an ally target's turn, then the duration of all buffs on that target is extended by 1 turn and the current turn ends.
Khaslana is immune to Crowd Control debuffs, has 1 Enhanced Basic ATK and 2 Enhanced Skills, but cannot use Ultimate. During the transformation, increases ATK by 40% and Max HP by 135%. After using an attack, restores HP equal to 20% of his Max HP. When Khaslana takes a killing blow, he will not get knocked down. Instead, he will restore HP equal to 25% of Max HP and immediately launch a final hit. For every 1 remaining Khaslana's extra turn, the final hit's DMG multiplier decreases by 12.5% of its original multiplier value.
When the transformation ends, increases all allies' SPD by 15% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Beginning of the End
skills.description:
Increases Max Technique Points by 3. When actively using this Technique, consumes 2 Technique Points to attack all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, regenerates Energy for allies and gains Skill Points and "Scourge." Deals Physical DMG to all enemies at the start of each wave.
If attacking a normal enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.

levels.description:
While Phainon is in the team, increases Max Technique Points by 3.
When actively using this Technique, consumes 2 Technique Points and immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, regenerates 25 Energy for allies and gains 2 "Scourge" and 1 Skill Point(s). Deals Physical DMG equal to 200% of Phainon's ATK to all enemies at the start of each wave.
If attacking a normal enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.

skills.name: Calamity: Soulscorch Edict
skills.description: Gains an equal amount of "Scourge" based on the number of enemies, and causes them to immediately take action. Gains "Soulscorch": Reduces DMG taken. After all enemy targets have taken action, launches Counter, and deals minor Physical DMG to all enemies that bounces 4 time(s), with each time dealing minor Physical DMG to one random enemy. The more actions enemies take, the higher the DMG.

levels.description:
Gains "Scourge" by an amount equal to the number of enemies and 1 stack of "Soulscorch," then causes all enemies to immediately take action.
While in the "Soulscorch" state, Khaslana takes 75% reduced DMG. After an enemy target attacks or takes action, gains 1 more stack of "Soulscorch." After said enemy targets finish their actions, immediately launches Counter, deals Physical DMG to all enemies equal to 20% of Khaslana's ATK, and additionally deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance being Physical DMG equal to 15% of Khaslana's ATK dealt to one random enemy. Afterward, "Soulscorch" is dispelled. Each "Soulscorch" stack increases the DMG multiplier of said Counter by 20% of its original multiplier value.
DMG dealt through this ability is considered as Skill DMG. If "Soulscorch" is still active at the start of Khaslana's extra turn, immediately launches Counter.

skills.description:
Dispels all debuffs on this unit. For every 1 "Scourge" consumed, bounces 4 time(s), with each time dealing minor Physical DMG to one random enemy.
If 4 "Scourge" are consumed, additionally deals massive Physical DMG that is evenly taken by all enemies.

levels.description:

For every 1 point of "Scourge" consumed, deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance being Physical DMG equal to 22.5% of Khaslana's ATK dealt to one random enemy. While in the Bleed state, at the start of each turn, the enemy target takes Physical DoT equal to 20% of their Max HP, up to 31.25% of Hysilens's ATK, lasting for 2 turn(s).

When entering combat, summons memosprite Evey. Each time this unit or Evey loses HP, increases CRIT DMG for this unit and Evey, and gains "Memoria."

skills.name: Grow Grace from Grit
skills.description: When Pearl holds "Certified Banger," she can consume "Certified Banger" to take a portion of DMG for all allies. When an ally target's current HP percentage reaches a certain threshold or lower, DMG taken gets reduced.

levels.description:
Pearl can use "Certified Banger" as Repellency. Each point of "Certified Banger" is equivalent to 200 point(s) of Repellency. When an ally target takes DMG, Pearl can consume Repellency to offset 60% of that DMG for the ally target. Pearl's "Certified Banger" lasts indefinitely and has a max limit of 50.

skills.name: Wings Heed No Borders
skills.description:
When an ally target uses an attack, or provides healing or Shield, Robin • Summeretto gains Vibes. Once Vibes reaches a certain value, summons "Summer Songbirds" Drummie and "Summer Songbirds" Paddie respectively. After all "Summer Songbirds" take the stage, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" enter the "Fever" state and deploy a Zone. When ally targets deal DMG inside the Zone, they ignore a portion of enemy targets' DEF.
While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" are immune to Crowd Control debuffs. Robin • Summeretto will not enter her turn until the "Fever" state ends.

levels.description:
Memosprite "Summer Songbirds" has an initial Max HP equal to 70% of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP and an initial SPD equal to 180% of Robin • Summeretto's SPD. When an ally target uses an attack, or when they provide healing or Shield for the first time in any target's turn, Robin • Summeretto gains Vibes by 1 point, capped at 50. While "Summer Songbirds" Bessie is on the field, if Robin • Summeretto's Vibes is 6 or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Drummie, and if Vibes is 12 or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Paddie. When all "Summer Songbirds" take the stage, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs inflicted upon Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds", starts the "Fever" state, and deploys a Zone. When ally targets deal DMG within the Zone, they ignore a percentage of enemy targets' DEF equal to (10% + Vibes × 0.5%).
While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" are immune to Crowd Control debuffs. Robin • Summeretto will not enter her turn until the "Fever" state ends.

sections.title: Physical Destruction starter role
paragraphs: This entry covers the Physical Destruction Trailblazer. Its early-game value is a straightforward choice between focused and adjacent-target attacks. GameBreak practice suggestion: identify which enemy has a Physical weakness, select the central target carefully when using a blast, and reserve Skill Points when a teammate has the more important next action. Position in the enemy lineup changes the value of a blast.

sections.title: Choose the Ultimate’s attack shape
paragraphs: The Basic Attack hits one target, while the Skill hits a target and adjacent enemies. The Ultimate offers a focused attack or a blast version. Its Talent rewards Weakness Break, with additional effects dependent on unlocked Traces. The exploration Technique restores party HP; it is not an in-battle healing Skill that can replace a healer every turn.

sections.title: Story access and Path selection
paragraphs: Physical Destruction is the starting playable Trailblazer form. Later story progression can provide other Paths, but their abilities belong to their own records. Before copying a team plan, check the Path and element shown in the character menu. The male and female starting appearances share this combat overview; a different portrait alone does not turn it into a different Path.

sections.title: A journey begins on Herta Space Station
paragraphs: The Trailblazer is the player’s viewpoint character, drawn into the Astral Express journey after the opening events at Herta Space Station. The official launch materials frame that journey as travel between worlds. This summary avoids revealing later Path changes or story outcomes. The media archive has both protagonist appearances and later forms, so use its labels before choosing a reference image.

sections.title: Use the break gauge as evidence
paragraphs: Practical checklist: watch the enemy’s Toughness gauge, not just HP, when judging a Break-related effect. Record which attack actually caused the Break and whether the same buffs were active in each attempt. If a build example uses another Trailblazer Path, stop and switch to the matching guide. A starting character’s accessibility is not evidence that one build is best for every late-game mode.

history.label: Version 1.0 starting form
history.detail: The official launch announcement dates Version 1.0 to 26 April 2023. The community record identifies Physical Destruction as the original playable Trailblazer form; later forms should retain separate histories.
